svg.title: 01 | Two-Pi test bench
svg.desc: The FEC is BACnet MS/TP. A BASrouter converts it to BACnet/IP for Worker Pi 1 and for the Niagara 4 station. Worker Pi 2 reads that station with baskStream. Each Pi builds a 223P Turtle model. The collector pulls GET /api/export.zip.
svg.text: Illustrative bench. The FEC is MS/TP. BACnet/IP starts at the BASrouter.
Points file only. Writes off by default
Pulls each Pi on a schedule. Port 8780. The zip contains model.ttl.
One named graph per edge. No socket to the FEC, the BASrouter, or the station.
reconcile compares the two graphs here.
BACnet/IP is the BASrouter to Worker Pi 1 and the BASrouter to the Niagara 4 station. Same color, same arrow.
Each Pi is a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B. It builds the 223P Turtle on the device and serves it at GET /api/export.zip.
The collector stores one named graph per edge. It does not read the MS/TP bus, the router, or the station.
